task: Switch native OTLP telemetry (metrics/logs/traces) from binary protobuf to JSON end-to-end so secret-bearing attributes can be masked before forwarding to analytics, mirroring the existing hook-event masking fix.

key_reasoning.reason: 5 components across the full pipeline: CLI connector env var (claude-code-otlp.ts), proxy ingestion handler (otlp.plugin.ts handleOtlp), spool storage format (spool-paths.ts + spool-io.ts, moving from concatenated protobuf bytes to a new NDJSON-per-record framing — a new abstraction), the forwarder (forwarder.ts forwardOtelStream, changing both content-type and per-record POST semantics), and a new OTLP-attribute-aware masking pass extending/adapting maskSecretsDeep for the nested resourceLogs/resourceSpans attribute arrays.

No exact precedent in this codebase for the new NDJSON-per-export-call spool framing or for masking OTLP's generic attributes[] array shape (the shipped hook-fix pattern is hook-schema-specific, not directly reusable); zero existing tests or fixtures touch handleOtlp/forwardOtelStream today, so the fix starts from scratch on fixtures as well as logic. Security red flag applied: bumped from L (4) to XL (5) because masking secrets before they reach the analytics backend is the explicit purpose of this fix (active data-leak remediation), not an incidental property.

Core intent (binary -> JSON, then mask) is explicit, but several concrete design decisions are open per the technical analysis: the exact NDJSON record framing to replace protobuf's concatenation trick, the masking target/skip-list for OTLP's nested attribute arrays (distinct from the hook pipeline's UNMASKED_FIELD_KEYS), and whether the fix's scope extends beyond Claude Code's bundled OTel SDK to other agent plugins (noted as unclear in Risk Indicators).

~6 modified files (claude-code-otlp.ts, otlp.plugin.ts, spool-paths.ts, spool-io.ts, forwarder.ts, security.ts) plus at least 1 new module for OTLP-attribute masking, spanning 4 directories (cli/commands/proxy/connectors, providers/plugins/sso/proxy/plugins, .../otlp-spool, utils) — directory spread crosses into the L band even though raw file counts sit near the M/L boundary.

4 distinct layers: CLI/config (Infrastructure), proxy request handling (API/Service), on-disk spool persistence (DB-Persistence, undergoing a schema-like reframing from binary blob to NDJSON), and the forwarder's External call to the analytics backend — matching the L criteria of 3-4 layers including a persistence format change.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L (4) to XL (5): secrets-masking of forwarded telemetry is the explicit security purpose of this fix, not an incidental concern.
